seoTitle: Duplicate Row Remover for CSV by Selected Columns
metaDescription: Remove duplicate rows from a CSV by chosen key columns, keeping the first or last, ignoring case and spaces. Lists what was removed.
intro: Finds rows that match on the columns you choose and keeps one of each, reporting which rows were removed.
why:
Duplicates usually mean the same person or item entered twice, but only some columns define sameness: an email, an ID, a name and date together. Choose those columns and ignore the rest.

Comparison can ignore letter case and surrounding spaces, so Ann@x.com and ann@x.com  match. You choose whether the first or the last occurrence survives. The summary lists the removed row numbers so you can check before using the result.
howTo: Paste the CSV with a header.
Type the columns that define a duplicate, or leave blank for whole rows.
Pick keep first or keep last.
Copy or download the cleaned CSV.
